facts.text: The hotel is at 45 St Martin's Lane in Covent Garden, in London's West End.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located on St Martin’s Lane in Covent Garden, in London’s West End, close to major attractions and theatres.

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Philippe Starck.
facts.excerpt: The hotel was designed by internationally renowned designer Philippe Starck, known for his bold and innovative style.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a lifestyle boutique hotel.
facts.excerpt: St Martins Lane is a lifestyle boutique hotel offering upscale design, spacious rooms, and premium amenities in central London.

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light and city views.
facts.excerpt: Yes, rooms feature large floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise natural light and city views.

facts.text: Rooms have customizable LED lighting.
facts.excerpt: Our thoughtfully designed rooms offer plush comfort, city views, and customizable LED lighting.

facts.text: Deluxe Garden Rooms have a private furnished terrace overlooking a garden.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a private furnished terrace overlooking a tranquil garden.

facts.text: The One Bedroom Suite is on the top floor, with a separate living area and London Eye views.
facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor, this suite offers privacy and sophistication with a separate living area and elevated views.

facts.text: The Penthouse has expansive living and dining spaces, an open-plan kitchen and a London Eye view.
facts.excerpt: Experience the ultimate in luxury in our Penthouse, featuring expansive living and dining spaces, an open-plan kitchen, and exceptional design throughout.

facts.text: The Corner Suite has dual-aspect windows and a large living area.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy abundant natural light from dual-aspect windows in this spacious corner suite, complete with a large living area and premium layout.

facts.text: Suites include a complimentary non-alcoholic minibar.
facts.excerpt: Suites offer extra space, premium amenities, complimentary minibar (non-alcoholic), and enhanced guest experiences.

facts.text: Larger rooms and suites accommodate families, including options with multiple beds.
facts.excerpt: Yes, larger rooms and suites accommodate families, including options with multiple beds.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: At St Martins Lane, dogs aren’t just allowed – they’re warmly welcomed.

facts.text: The hotel has a fully equipped gym.
facts.excerpt: It’s fully equipped and designed to access each muscle group with state of the art machinery and a well stocked selection of weights.

facts.text: The hotel has eight meeting and event spaces.
facts.excerpt: With eight uniquely designed spaces, we take pride in crafting tailor-made experiences that cater to your group’s every desire and need.

facts.text: Blind Spot is a hidden late-night speakeasy cocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: find your way to our secret bar, a late-night speakeasy offering a range of cocktails to tempt your tastebuds.

facts.text: EllaMia is a modern cafe bringing LA's craft coffee scene to London, turning into EllaMia After Dark with bites and cocktails at night.
facts.excerpt: A stylish, modern café that elevates the everyday: bringing a taste of LA’s craft coffee scene right to London. By night, EllaMia After Dark switches things up with delicious bites and expertly crafted cocktails.

facts.text: Breakfast is served daily at Restaurant 45.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is served daily at Restaurant 45 with a variety of seasonal and international options.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in The Den.
facts.excerpt: Yes, afternoon tea is served in The Den, including themed and seasonal experiences.

facts.text: The Studio has an open-plan layout with a freestanding bathtub.
facts.excerpt: The Studio offers an open-plan layout with elevated comfort, featuring a freestanding bathtub and generous living space.

facts.text: The Standard Room overlooks Hop Gardens or Mays Court.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the space with natural light, creating a calm and functional retreat overlooking Hop Gardens or Mays Court.

facts.text: Superior Rooms have a walk-in shower, with a bathtub in select rooms.
facts.excerpt: Walk-in shower (bathtub in select rooms)

contradictions.note: p3 lists Spotlight under 'Afternoon Tea & Cocktails' but its FAQ says afternoon tea is served in The Den

sources.excerpt: Yes, afternoon tea is served in The Den, including themed and seasonal experiences.
